# `matter/fluid/MixedResolutionFluidContracts.js`

> **Source:** `engine/matter/fluid/MixedResolutionFluidContracts.js`

Fail-closed contracts for a future conservative mixed-resolution fluid solver. This module deliberately grants no execution or physical authority. It freezes the evidence a GPU implementation must satisfy before fine particles, coarse packets, or sparse-grid cells may replace one another as canonical mass owners.

## Functions

### `createMixedResolutionFluidConservationReceipt({ operation, before, after, tolerance = {}, } = {})`

Create an independently derived six-invariant conservation receipt.

### `createMixedResolutionFluidHandoffPlan(input)`

Create a deterministic plan after validating every currently provable conservation, ownership, coupling, transition, and wake invariant. Version 1 remains `contract-only`; callers cannot opt into GPU dispatch or physical authority by setting flags in untrusted input.

### `validateMixedResolutionFluidHandoffPlan(plan)`

Revalidate a serialized or previously created contract-only plan.

### `requireMixedResolutionFluidPhysicalAuthority(plan)`

Explicit physical-authority gate. Version 1 always rejects because no live solver certificate/dispatch receipt exists yet.

## Constants

- `MIXED_RESOLUTION_FLUID_PLAN_SCHEMA`
- `MIXED_RESOLUTION_FLUID_PLAN_VERSION`
- `MIXED_RESOLUTION_FLUID_RECEIPT_SCHEMA`
- `MIXED_RESOLUTION_FLUID_RECEIPT_VERSION`
- `MIXED_RESOLUTION_FLUID_ABI_VERSION`
- `MIXED_RESOLUTION_FLUID_CARRIER_KINDS`
- `MIXED_RESOLUTION_FLUID_SUPPORT_RULES`
- `MIXED_RESOLUTION_FLUID_REQUIRED_WAKE_SIGNALS`
- `MIXED_RESOLUTION_FLUID_STAGE_ORDER` — The only accepted pass order for the first physical GPU implementation.
- `MIXED_RESOLUTION_FLUID_GPU_ABI` — Portable storage ABI reserved by the contract. The current SPH demo does not allocate or dispatch these records.
